capabilities: show anchor icons next to linked headings in the gutter
list all notes linking to a heading via a context menu
jump to the exact link line in the source note
rename a heading and update all links to it
count embeds and same-file heading links as backlinks
extras: Not yet in the official community plugin list; installation via BRAT or manual download pending acceptance (PR mentioned in README).
intentEvidence: Vault-wide header backlinks: Scans markdown files for wiki-style links and embeds that include a # fragment pointing at a heading.
problem: Obsidian's core backlinks are note-level; heading-level links ([[Note#Heading]]) don't show which headings are referenced or from where, at the heading itself.

relations.evidence: Rename this heading… action (uses the built-in Obsidian command) that renames the heading and updates all links

summary: Shows anchor icons in the editor gutter next to headings targeted by internal links and lets you jump to each note that references the heading.
